headlines.text: Bangladesh humble Australia with worst total in contest as Hasan takes 6-55. Australia dismissed for lowest total against Bangladesh as Hasan Mahmud claims career-best on Day One of first Test.
Photos: Hope fades in Colombia as teams dig for earthquake survivors. Colombian rescuers battle time to save lives after deadly 7.4 earthquake, as hopes dwindle in search for survivors.
US diplomat calls Israeli settler siege of West Bank homes ‘act of terror’. Israeli settlers have blocked the homes of three Palestinian families in Qusra, cutting them off from food and supplies.

Part of children’s hospital collapses in Colombia earthquake. Security cameras captured the moment part of a children's hospital in Cali collapsed.
As temperatures soar, ‘exceptionally serious’ drought imperils UK farmers. Farmers trying to adapt to extreme weather say even with the best planning, their industry is facing its toughest test.
Three US states to hold executions on same day for first time since 2010. The last three executions on the same day happened 16 years ago, in Louisiana, Ohio and Texas.
Swiatek sinks Svitolina to set up Rybakina title clash in Toronto. Iga Swiatek will face Elena Rybakina for the Toronto tennis title, as Elina Svitolina and Coco Gauff exit in semifinals.

Messi plays in Inter Miami defeat by Leon only hours after retirement hint. Argentina star Lionel Messi hinted at retirement on Wednesday before featuring in Inter Miami's defeat by Leon.
Israeli strikes in south Lebanon a ‘violation of international law’: PM. Prime Minister Nawaf Salam rejects Israel's claim that villages destroyed in southern Lebanon were military sites.
Palestinian women in Gaza face legal hurdles in divorce struggles. Amid legal struggles, Gaza women opt for quicker divorces, sacrificing rights to escape prolonged court battles.
‘They destroyed us’: Palestinian family sleeps in the open after demolition. Palestinian family's home demolished despite court order, leaving them homeless under sweltering heat in the West Bank.

Police rescue 60 cats and kittens from abandoned sailboat off Washington beach after 6-day operation. Tacoma police spent six days rescuing 60 cats from an abandoned 40-foot sailboat off Owens Beach, with many animals found frightened and malnourished.

Dallas-Fort Worth airport to install Islamic foot wash stations inside bathrooms. Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport plans to add ablution stations to Terminal D restrooms in a privately funded $300,000 project sparking debate.

Jemele Hill claims to know what DiJonai Carrington meant with 'White privilege' post, so what was it?. Jemele Hill says it was "pretty clear" what DiJonai Carrington meant by her "White privilege" post, but has yet to explain it to anyone who asked.

Clueless WNBA attacks 'bad-faith' fans who don't want biological men ruining women's sports. The WNBA task force on transgender athletes offered another update with no eligibility definition, scheduling more meetings while scolding critics.

Rubio rejects RFK's 'crazy' diet, jokes Pop-Tarts are 'one of the great American innovations'. Secretary of State Marco Rubio joked about what he thinks of Pop-Tarts while mocking Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s sauerkraut diet on a podcast with his wife.

Convicted rapist who preyed on women at America's top party school faces reckoning after courthouse dash. Arian Eteghaei received 30 years to life for forcible rape and sexual assault of multiple victims while a student at UC Santa Barbara, then fled custody.

Composer of 'Halo' video games says he was disinvited from convention event for being a Republican politician. Video game composer Marty O'Donnell says SacAnime rescinded his Halo 25 reunion invite after LGBTQ staff objected to statements made on a podcast appearance during his campaign.

Birth order linked to 150 health conditions in study of 10 million American siblings. First-born children showed higher rates of autism, ADHD and food allergies, while second-born siblings faced more substance use disorders and migraines.

Los Angeles Lakers buyer, ex-Disney chief Bob Iger once said rooting for team was 'not in my DNA'. Bob Iger once told JJ Redick he "couldn't root for the Lakers" as a lifelong Knicks fan. Now he helped buy the Los Angeles Lakers for $12.5 billion.

Deshaun Watson, Shedeur Sanders give Browns a preseason quarterback battle worth watching. Deshaun Watson starts Saturday in Chicago while Shedeur Sanders gets the Aug. 22 home game against Buffalo in Cleveland's quarterback competition.

Texas judge accused of 'doxxing' political critic faces federal lawsuit, growing push to oust him from office. West Texas judge Terry Johnson allegedly posted a critic's Social Security and driver's license numbers on Facebook, sparking a federal lawsuit.

Unearthed interview exposes Dem senator's past support for reparations: 'There is a debt unpaid'. Jon Ossoff said in 2019 he would support reparations legislation, calling slavery a "debt unpaid." His resurfaced comments now raise questions.

Is Orlando destined to be one of the next MLB cities? The Orlando Dreamers are looking to make it happen. The Orlando Dreamers are making their case for MLB expansion in Florida, citing tourism, media market size and a proposed stadium near SeaWorld.

Jim Nantz speaks out on 'great friend' Tony Romo's OWI arrest,  says he will 'always' be there for him. Jim Nantz spoke out on Tony Romo's OWI arrest, revealing he has conversed with his booth partner and his longtime friend, as J.J. Watt will be with him during the 2026 NFL season.

Campus antisemitism extends beyond student protests and into classrooms, ADL warns. A new ADL report said 27.3% of Jewish students observed antisemitic faculty behavior, documenting alleged incidents at UC Berkeley, UCLA and Columbia.

New indictment alleges Nick Reiner was lying in wait before killing his parents. A grand jury has indicted Nick Reiner on murder charges in the killings of his parents, Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner, and adds the allegation that he was lying in wait before attacking them.

Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century. As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered. It was the Spain's first total solar eclipse in more than a century.

3 men set for lethal injection on same day in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma. Three men in Tennessee, Alabama and Oklahoma are scheduled for lethal injection Thursday in a rare convergence of executions on the same day in the U.S.

Inflation eases in July as gasoline and grocery prices fall. Consumer prices in July were up 3.4% from a year ago — a smaller annual increase than in May or June. The news makes it less likely the Fed will feel the need to raise interest rates in September.
